title: CampusFix AI response
description: Structured response contract used by the CampusFix AI LLM backend.

answer.description: The direct, helpful response to the user's question.

category.description: Identified campus IT issue category or general IT.

next_step.description: The next practical troubleshooting action for the user.

resolved.description: Whether the user has confirmed that the issue is fixed.

needs_escalation.description: Whether the issue should be escalated to campus IT.

ticket_summary.description: A concise summary suitable for an IT support ticket.
